cards.example_en: Our school teaches equality so every student is treated fairly.
cards.example_zh: 我们学校教导平等，所以每个学生都得到公平对待。

cards.example_en: The hanging mobile regained equilibrium when I moved one ornament.
cards.example_zh: 我移动了一个饰物后，悬挂的装饰架恢复了平衡。
cards.explain_zh: 通常不可数；常用于经济、生态或物理中的平衡。

cards.example_en: The balanced scales showed the equivalence of the two weights.
cards.example_zh: 天平保持平衡，表明两边的重量相等。
cards.explain_zh: 常用equivalence between A and B表示两者等同。

cards.example_en: Establishing equivalence between qualifications from different countries can make it easier for skilled workers to find employment abroad.
cards.example_zh: 确立不同国家学历资格之间的等同性，可以帮助技术人才更容易地在国外就业。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Please erase the old labels before drawing a new diagram.
cards.example_zh: 画新图之前，请擦去旧标注。

cards.example_en: For me, the essence of friendship is being there.
cards.example_zh: 对我来说，友谊的真谛就是陪伴与支持。
cards.explain_zh: in essence 表示“本质上”，用于概括核心观点。

cards.example_en: For me, the essence of friendship is being there.
cards.example_zh: 对我来说，友谊的真谛就是陪伴与支持。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: These two phones are essentially the same, apart from colour.
cards.example_zh: 这两部手机除了颜色不同，基本上是一样的。
cards.explain_zh: 是副词，不是形容词；常用于概括核心事实。

cards.example_en: These two phones are essentially the same, apart from colour.
cards.example_zh: 这两部手机除了颜色不同，基本上是一样的。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: By my estimation, we need three more chairs.
cards.example_zh: 据我估计，我们还需要三把椅子。
cards.explain_zh: estimation常指估算过程；具体估价常用estimate。

cards.example_en: Studying philosophy can help students question assumptions and develop stronger arguments about complex ethical issues.
cards.example_zh: 学习哲学有助于学生质疑既有假设，并就复杂的伦理问题提出更有力的论证。
cards.source: Word Atlas context; product gloss correction

cards.example_en: The committee reviewed the ethics of collecting personal data.
cards.example_zh: 委员会审查了收集个人数据所涉及的伦理问题。

cards.example_en: Her relief was evident when the puppy returned.
cards.example_zh: 小狗回来时，她明显松了一口气。
cards.explain_zh: 常用It is evident that...表示显然……。

cards.example_en: The museum explains the evolutionary history of whales.
cards.example_zh: 博物馆介绍了鲸的进化史。

cards.meaning_zh: 前任的；以前的（前缀 ex-）
cards.example_en: The ex-president returned to the university to give a lecture.
cards.example_zh: 这位前总统回到大学发表演讲。

cards.example_en: The team must execute the plan within the agreed budget.
cards.example_zh: 团队必须在约定预算内执行计划。

cards.example_en: The picnic plan was simple, but its execution proved tricky.
cards.example_zh: 野餐计划很简单，但实施起来却不容易。
cards.explain_zh: 既可指执行计划，也可指执行死刑，须看语境。

cards.example_en: We found the exit at the back of the cinema.
cards.example_zh: 我们在电影院后部找到了出口。
cards.explain_zh: 名词指“出口”，动词指“离开”；不要与 exist 混淆。

cards.example_en: We need your expertise to repair this old clock.
cards.example_zh: 修理这座旧钟需要你的专业技能。
cards.explain_zh: 不可数；某领域的专长用expertise in。

cards.example_en: Universities can support local businesses by sharing their expertise in renewable energy and sustainable manufacturing.
cards.example_zh: 大学可以通过分享可再生能源和可持续制造领域的专业知识来支持当地企业。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Please give me explicit instructions for assembling this wooden shelf.
cards.example_zh: 请给我明确的说明，告诉我如何组装这个木架。
cards.explain_zh: explicit指明说的；implicit指未明说但可推知的。

cards.example_en: Please give me explicit instructions for assembling this wooden shelf.
cards.example_zh: 请给我明确的说明，告诉我如何组装这个木架。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The instructions explicitly state that dictionaries are not allowed.
cards.example_zh: 说明中明确规定不允许使用词典。

cards.example_en: Many consumers consider it immoral for companies to exploit vulnerable workers in pursuit of higher profits.
cards.example_zh: 许多消费者认为，企业为了追求更高利润而剥削弱势劳动者是不道德的。
cards.source: Word Atlas context; product gloss correction

cards.example_en: The chart shows exponential growth in the number of users.
cards.example_zh: 图表显示用户数量呈指数式增长。

cards.example_en: This soft fabric will make a comfortable summer dress.
cards.example_zh: 这种柔软的布料做夏季连衣裙会很舒服。
cards.explain_zh: 泛指布料常不可数；不同种类可用fabrics。

cards.example_en: Community centres strengthen the social fabric by bringing together residents from different cultural and economic backgrounds.
cards.example_zh: 社区中心让不同文化与经济背景的居民聚在一起，从而巩固社会纽带。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Cooking together revealed a new facet of her personality.
cards.example_zh: 一起做饭展现了她性格中新的一面。
cards.explain_zh: 常用 a facet of，指复杂事物的一个方面。

cards.example_en: Public transport affects almost every facet of urban life, from employment opportunities to air quality.
cards.example_zh: 公共交通几乎影响城市生活的每个方面，从就业机会到空气质量。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: These sliding doors facilitate access for people using wheelchairs.
cards.example_zh: 这些推拉门方便使用轮椅的人进出。
cards.explain_zh: 后接名词或动名词，不用facilitate somebody to do。

cards.example_en: These sliding doors facilitate access for people using wheelchairs.
cards.example_zh: 这些推拉门方便使用轮椅的人进出。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The factorial of four is twenty-four.
cards.example_zh: 四的阶乘是二十四。

cards.example_en: The science faculty has moved into a new building.
cards.example_zh: 理学院已搬进一栋新楼。
cards.explain_zh: 英式常指大学院系，美式常指全体教员。

cards.example_en: After the long hike, fatigue made my legs shake.
cards.example_zh: 长途徒步后，我累得双腿发抖。
cards.explain_zh: 通常为不可数名词，比tiredness更正式。

cards.example_en: My tutor gave me helpful feedback on my essay.
cards.example_zh: 导师针对我的作文给了我有用的反馈。
cards.explain_zh: 不可数，不说a feedback或feedbacks；用some feedback。

cards.example_en: Crop rotation helps farmers maintain soil fertility and reduce their reliance on chemical pesticides.
cards.example_zh: 作物轮作有助于农民保持土壤肥力，并减少对化学农药的依赖。
cards.source: Word Atlas context; product gloss correction

cards.example_en: The course covers fetal development before birth.
cards.example_zh: 这门课程涵盖出生前的胎儿发育。

cards.example_en: He stayed in bed because he had a fever.
cards.example_zh: 他因为发烧而卧床休息。
cards.explain_zh: 表示发烧常说have a fever，也可说have a temperature。

cards.example_en: The fabric contains a strong synthetic fiber.
cards.example_zh: 这块织物含有一种结实的合成纤维。

cards.example_en: We spotted a shark's fin just above the water.
cards.example_zh: 我们看见一个鲨鱼鳍刚刚露出水面。
cards.explain_zh: 指潜水脚蹼时常用复数fins。

cards.example_en: Our holiday budget is finite, so choose carefully.
cards.example_zh: 我们的度假预算有限，所以要仔细选择。
cards.explain_zh: 读音重音在首音节；勿按finish的元音读。

cards.example_en: The ripe peach had sweet flesh and a small stone.
cards.example_zh: 这颗熟桃果肉香甜，果核很小。
cards.explain_zh: 一般不可数；食用的肉通常用meat，不用flesh。

cards.example_en: This job gives me flexibility to collect my daughter.
cards.example_zh: 这份工作时间灵活，方便我去接女儿。
cards.explain_zh: 既可指安排可变通，也可指身体或材料的柔韧性。

cards.example_en: Greater flexibility in working hours can help employees balance professional responsibilities with family commitments.
cards.example_zh: 更灵活的工作时间能帮助员工平衡工作职责与家庭义务。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Please flip the card to read the explanation on the back.
cards.example_zh: 请翻转卡片，阅读背面的解释。

cards.example_en: Employment patterns are increasingly fluid, requiring workers to update their skills throughout their professional lives.
cards.example_zh: 就业模式日益多变，要求劳动者在整个职业生涯中不断更新技能。
cards.explain_zh: 日常语境多指液体；科学中的fluid也包括气体。

cards.example_en: The industry remains in flux as new technologies appear.
cards.example_zh: 随着新技术出现，这个行业仍在不断变化。

cards.example_en: A footnote explains where the historical figures came from.
cards.example_zh: 一条脚注解释了这些历史数据的来源。

cards.example_en: The agreement was formally approved by the council.
cards.example_zh: 这项协议得到了议会的正式批准。

word.example_en: Greater flexibility in working hours can help employees balance professional responsibilities with family commitments.
word.example_zh: 更灵活的工作时间能帮助员工平衡工作职责与家庭义务。
